boss_biting.name: Boss-Biting
boss_biting.text: Leaves especially memorable marks on large targets.

grounded.name: Grounded
grounded.text: Heavy rhythm hits land with better manners and worse outcomes.

kindled.name: Kindled
kindled.text: Relic heat gathers around every strike.

of_sparks.name: of Sparks
of_sparks.text: Critical edges leave a small amber-blue answer.

of_spite.name: of Spite
of_spite.text: Gets increasingly personal as health falls.

of_the_vault.name: of the Vault
of_the_vault.text: Carries a restrained trace of old vault power.

plated.name: Plated
plated.text: One more sensible layer between fur and consequences.

prospector.name: Prospector's
prospector.text: Loose Run Scrip has nowhere to hide.

quickened.name: Quickened
quickened.text: A lighter rhythm without losing its shape.

scavengers.name: Scavenger's
scavengers.text: Finds value where polite people see rubble.

sparkcaller.name: Sparkcaller
sparkcaller.text: Critical hits wake a small Relic spark.

warded.name: Warded
warded.text: A quiet ward softens incoming blows.

aftershock_receipt.name: Aftershock Receipt
aftershock_receipt.text: Heavy hits echo for 25% base power after 0.18s; echoes stay with their target.

bubble_bargain.name: Bubble Bargain
bubble_bargain.text: The first burn or poison on each foe grants 3 ward; hold at most 15.

burden_bell.name: Burden Bell
burden_bell.text: Heavy hits delay the foe by up to 0.25s. Repeated delays weaken until the foe recovers.

critical_shelter.name: Quiet Chime
critical_shelter.text: Critical kills restore 4 ward, up to 15.

crooked_constellation.name: Crooked Constellation
crooked_constellation.text: Every fifth shot adds a Lightning hit for 34% base power.

first_light.name: First Light
first_light.text: The first critical hit against each foe calls a Relic spark.

frostbell_chime.name: Frostbell Chime
frostbell_chime.text: The first hit on each foe delays its next action.

frostbell_shatter.name: Frostbell Shatter
frostbell_shatter.text: Each foe's first hit delays it; a heavy follow-up shatters for 25% base power.

gilded_greed.name: Gilded Greed
gilded_greed.text: Gilded enemies may spill one extra treasure burst.

grudgekeeper.name: Grudgekeeper
grudgekeeper.text: A defeated foe stores force for the next encounter.

hoardquake.name: Hoardquake
hoardquake.text: A Legendary pickup primes the next heavy gold shockwave.

last_lantern.name: Last Lantern
last_lantern.text: Once per run, fatal damage leaves one HP and snuffs its lantern.

last_laugh.name: Last Laugh
last_laugh.text: Below 40% health, attacks gain a strange second wind.

mimic_appetite.name: Mimic Appetite
mimic_appetite.text: Opening a cache primes +40% power on the next hit. Does not stack.

moon_echo.name: Moon Echo
moon_echo.text: A near miss primes a ghost copy of the next attack.

rooted_revenge.name: Rooted Revenge
rooted_revenge.text: Every fourth enemy hit you survive returns a thorn for 30% base power.

shardstorm.name: Shardstorm
shardstorm.text: High-tier loot primes the next hit with relic-shard energy.

storm_receipt.name: Storm Receipt
storm_receipt.text: Three distinct targets within 4 seconds spark the third for 60% base power.

cinder_crown.status: Existing Furnace Regent intro identity; articulated combat phases pending

first_hoard.status: BETA: Hoard Dragon proxy; authored Hollow Crown needed

frostbell_hollows.status: TEMP: procedural frost/chime rig prototype, not canonical body art

moonfen.status: TEMP: procedural lantern-jackal rig prototype, not canonical body art

mossglass_wilds.status: BETA: existing intro tree/root guardian reused; authored combat phases pending

nullglass_expanse.status: BETA: armoured proxy; authored Unchosen needed

skyhook_bastion.status: BETA: armoured proxy; authored Chainwarden needed

starfall_archive.status: BETA: caster proxy; authored Redactor needed

sunken_gearworks.status: BETA: armoured golem proxy; authored Drowned Engine needed

ashtrail_hunter.name: Patient Aim
ashtrail_hunter.text: Each foe's first critical hit adds 30% power. 5 less HP; steady critical builds.

emberhorn.name: Rescue Furnace
emberhorn.text: Every fourth attack kindles a short burn. 10 less HP; burns reward steady pressure.

glimmerfin.name: Unrequested Encore
glimmerfin.text: Every sixth attack echoes for 35% power. 8 less HP; rewards fast weapons.

gloomlet.name: Affectionate Denial
gloomlet.text: The first enemy hit per foe is 30% weaker. 8 less HP; short fights favour you.

moonkip.name: Moonlit Opening
moonkip.text: Each foe's first hit deals 25% more damage. 12 less HP; approach 15% faster.

mosskin.name: Patient Shelter
mosskin.text: Recover 2 HP after each nonfatal enemy hit. 15 more HP; approach 15% slower.

nightstage_drifter.name: Final Bow
nightstage_drifter.text: Hits deal 15% more power below 35% foe HP. 10 less HP; strong finishes.

pebblewyrm.name: Load-Bearing Confidence
pebblewyrm.text: Every fifth attack delays the foe by 0.25s. 12 more HP; approach 12% slower.

relic_beast.name: Pocket Promise
relic_beast.text: Each fifth foe leaves 8 extra Run Scrip. Any weapon; no combat penalty.

ruin_warden.name: Stand Together
ruin_warden.text: Enemy hits above 15 damage are softened 15%. 8 more HP; approach 10% slower.

vault_runner.name: Courier's Advance
vault_runner.text: Each kill stores 10% power for the next foe. 8 less HP; approach 12% faster.

velvet_astrologer.name: Read the Stars
velvet_astrologer.text: Every fifth attack restores 2 HP. 8 less HP; attack rhythm sustains you.

Archivist: Tell me who you met. Ruins are full of people reduced to architecture.
The dead rarely correct my spelling. I try not to take advantage.
Relic Keeper: Put your pack down. You do not have to be useful every waking moment.
I will tend the shrine. You tend the bruises. Neither job needs a hero.
Salvager: Set it on the bench. If the grip slips, the shine will not save you.
Warm fire, sound hinges, sharp steel. That is a home worth keeping.

LINES.speaker: relic_beast
LINES.text: I brought the lost buckle back. Also this shiny thing. Also three snacks.

LINES.speaker: relic_beast
LINES.text: You stayed beside me in there. Next time I carry your bag.

LINES.speaker: relic_beast
LINES.text: Is that chest friendly? I can offer it a biscuit.

LINES.speaker: relic_beast
LINES.text: We brought everyone home! Can we count treasure after supper?

LINES.speaker: relic_beast
LINES.text: I left the treasure. I did not leave you.

LINES.speaker: emberhorn
LINES.text: I can take the next watch. Nobody goes cold while I am here.

LINES.speaker: emberhorn
LINES.text: Yes, I rushed the door. No, I will not rush the next one. Probably.

LINES.speaker: emberhorn
LINES.text: Patch kept the rescue furnace burning. I want to be that reliable.

LINES.speaker: emberhorn
LINES.text: Everyone made it. Good. That was the part I was worried about.

LINES.speaker: emberhorn
LINES.text: I went too fast. Next time I watch the opening before I charge.

LINES.speaker: mosskin
LINES.text: Sit in my shade. The garden can wait a little longer.

LINES.speaker: mosskin
LINES.text: I kept the way home clear. A shield is useful after the fight, too.

LINES.speaker: mosskin
LINES.text: The roots broke the lock. Very slowly. I admire their method.

LINES.speaker: mosskin
LINES.text: The path is safe again. Rest now; I will take the watch.

LINES.speaker: mosskin
LINES.text: A retreat is a path home. We can grow stronger here.

LINES.speaker: moonkip
LINES.text: I checked both exits. The treasure can wait until you are through.

LINES.speaker: moonkip
LINES.text: That lock was insulting. I accepted the challenge politely.

LINES.speaker: moonkip
LINES.text: I returned the key. Nobody specified which pocket.

LINES.speaker: moonkip
LINES.text: Nobody saw us leave. Everybody who matters came with us.

LINES.speaker: moonkip
LINES.text: The exit worked. Next time we avoid needing it quite so urgently.

LINES.speaker: pebblewyrm
LINES.text: Put the heavy bag on mine. We will complain together on the way home.

LINES.speaker: pebblewyrm
LINES.text: The bridge held! I knew it would. I did check twice.

LINES.speaker: pebblewyrm
LINES.text: My Core came from a foundation stone. Staying put is a family talent.

LINES.speaker: pebblewyrm
LINES.text: Still standing! I told you these legs were dependable.

LINES.speaker: pebblewyrm
LINES.text: I can try again. After a sit. A very determined sit.

LINES.speaker: glimmerfin
LINES.text: You came back! Excellent. The welcome deserves at least one chorus.

LINES.speaker: glimmerfin
LINES.text: I found a shell that remembers a voice. Let us listen before we sell it.

LINES.speaker: glimmerfin
LINES.text: The shrine was quiet today. I sang softly. That still counts as restraint.

LINES.speaker: glimmerfin
LINES.text: A fine ending! Save the applause until the wounded have seats.

LINES.speaker: glimmerfin
LINES.text: That performance needs rehearsal. Nobody is being replaced.

LINES.speaker: gloomlet
LINES.text: Your bag strap was broken. It is fixed now. No public ceremony, please.

LINES.speaker: gloomlet
LINES.text: I kept your seat. For tactical reasons.

LINES.speaker: gloomlet
LINES.text: Yes, I came back for you. Let us never discuss this in front of the others.

LINES.speaker: gloomlet
LINES.text: Everyone survived. An acceptable result. Stop smiling at me.

LINES.speaker: gloomlet
LINES.text: You came back for me. Reckless. Appreciated. Do not quote that.

LINES.speaker: vault_runner
LINES.text: A rich vault with one exit is a trap with expensive wallpaper.

LINES.speaker: vault_runner
LINES.text: I marked the way back. Getting paid requires getting out.

LINES.speaker: vault_runner
LINES.text: Paid, alive, and no doors locked behind us. I like those numbers.

LINES.speaker: vault_runner
LINES.text: The vault keeps its treasure today. I kept the map and my legs.

LINES.speaker: ruin_warden
LINES.text: Drink something warm. I will watch the gate.

LINES.speaker: ruin_warden
LINES.text: We count people before treasure. Every time.

LINES.speaker: ruin_warden
LINES.text: Everyone accounted for. Now we can count the spoils.

LINES.speaker: ruin_warden
LINES.text: I held the retreat. We will mend the line before we return.

LINES.speaker: nightstage_drifter
LINES.text: An encore is only worth it if the whole audience survives.

LINES.speaker: nightstage_drifter
LINES.text: You kept a seat for me. That is a better welcome than applause.

LINES.speaker: nightstage_drifter
LINES.text: The curtain comes down with everyone standing. That is my kind of finale.

LINES.speaker: nightstage_drifter
LINES.text: Rough rehearsal. Keep my place; I still owe you a better ending.

LINES.speaker: velvet_astrologer
LINES.text: The sky gives probabilities. I pack bandages.

LINES.speaker: velvet_astrologer
LINES.text: I checked the route twice. Confidence should have a foundation.

LINES.speaker: velvet_astrologer
LINES.text: A fortunate outcome. The spare bandages can wait another night.

LINES.speaker: velvet_astrologer
LINES.text: I misread that opening. No stars to blame; I will mark it in my notes.

LINES.speaker: ashtrail_hunter
LINES.text: Fresh tracks outside the gate. Two feet, then four. Watch the bends.

LINES.speaker: ashtrail_hunter
LINES.text: The wind has changed. Leave after it carries our scent away.

LINES.speaker: ashtrail_hunter
LINES.text: No fresh tracks behind us. We can put the packs down.

LINES.speaker: ashtrail_hunter
LINES.text: That trail turned ugly. We take a different approach next time.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: I rebuilt this gate from salvage. Good work should outlast its first owner.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Sera checks the Core. I check what protects it. Neither of us signs off on guesswork.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Ilex found the original furnace plans. Finally, instructions that fit the machine.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Back on your feet? Put the weapon down and tell me where it caught.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: You kept the grip steady through a long run. Now let me check the binding.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: You came back. That is the part I cannot replace. We will check your gear next.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Do not buy another weapon yet. Tell me what broke your rhythm first.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Try the grip here before taking it into a fight. Keep the receipt until it fits.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: The new balance is deliberate. Give that movement room on your next trip.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Different reach, different opening. Take one clean swing before you trust it.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Fine edge. Unusual balance. Keep the old weapon until you learn this one.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: That is a named relic. I will inspect the fittings; Ilex will want its history.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: A Crownroot relic. No rushing this inspection. Power still needs a sound grip.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: A suspiciously generous chest? Inspect the hinge before congratulating yourself.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: A room full of healing supplies and an empty circle. I would sharpen something.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: Cores remember what they were asked to protect. Treating them as spare fuel destroys that purpose.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: Patch keeps the furnace warm for Emberhorn. Care is often less dramatic than people expect.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: A Core can remember a promise without knowing who made it. We help it find the rest.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: Put your pack down. A long road does not make rest optional.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: Rest first. A living Core matters more than the treasure left behind.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: The shrine can support you more steadily now. It does not ask you to prove anything.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: Let the relic settle before you bind it. Strength is useful; consent matters too.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: Crownroot joins the fragments left by the Crownfall. We will tend what wakes inside it.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: If you are saving every tonic for an emergency, tell me what you call the last fight.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: Starfall erased names before it erased people. I left while mine still belonged to me.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: Record what you saw, including what you could not identify. Certainty can wait for evidence.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: Patch repairs what remains. I record who it belonged to. We need both.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: Tell me where you went. A map gains value from a witness who returned.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: We have a surviving witness. Start with the attack you did not recognize.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: A named relic has a history. Your discovery belongs beside its old owners.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: Collect the board reward. You did the work; the promise should be kept.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: The guardian fell. Tell me what changed around it before we count the spoils.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: That immaculate empty hall? Architects rarely install a grand entrance for a broom cupboard.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: Another sealed room behind a cracked wall. The builders were less subtle than they thought.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Sound footing and a clean opening. Keep doing what brought you home.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: You returned alive and freed something the Crown had kept. Let us tend both.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: A victory with a witness. That is considerably better than a heroic rumour.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: The weapon is repairable. You need a rest before another run.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: You survived. Let the shrine hold some of the weight tonight.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: Tell me how the fight turned. A defeat can still leave a useful account.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: I will check the string and grip. The draw should pull cleanly, not fight you.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Keep the bolt clear while I inspect the catch. A stiff trigger wastes your opening.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Two blades, two hands. Recover one while the other makes its opening.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Check each fastening. A claw that turns in your palm is working for the other side.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Let the charge finish before the release. Your footing matters as much as the spell.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Use the reach. If the blade drags you forward, reset your stance.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Let the head carry the blow. Then bring it home before the counterattack.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Keep the point between you and the threat. Recover straight after the thrust.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: A clear arc, then a clean release. Check behind you before you start the rotation.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Commit to the cut, then recover your footing. Weight is useful when you control it.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Small movement, precise aim. Keep the focus steady through the release.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Do not squeeze the focus. Give its charge room and guide the release.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: The Verdant Mirror diverted the forest spring. If it fell, we should check whether water reaches the gardens again.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: The Mirror held stolen spring water in its roots. Breaking its hold helps living things downstream.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: Moonfen lanterns lure travellers off the path. Record which lights moved before the attack.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: Those Gearworks machines kept working after their makers died. We should find who was chained to the engine.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: The Archive Redactor erases names from records. I survived by leaving Starfall before mine vanished.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: You escaped with little strength left. Sit by the shrine before deciding what comes next.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: You cleared the Rootglass Vault. Bring the Crownroot to Sera before we catalogue it.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: You extracted from the Siege. Empty the bag before the next fight; I want to see what survived.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: The Crownfall left living Cores inside abandoned work. A relic may remember its maker even when our books do not.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: A rediscovered name can help a Core recognize an old bond. Bring the Archive account to the shrine.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: Some witnesses were erased twice: first from the records, then from the stories told about them. Compare the two accounts.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Leave the satchel here, little courier. I will mend it while you eat.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: You do not have to rescue everyone alone, Emberhorn. That is why we keep a gate.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: The garden can spare you for supper, Mosskin. I checked.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Moonkip, tell me which lock failed. I want to repair it before you prove your point again.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Pebblewyrm, put the bags down. Being dependable includes letting me carry one.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Glimmerfin, save the chorus for supper. I need to hear whether this blade rings true.

LINES.speaker: Salvager
LINES.text: Gloomlet, I left the spare binding beside your seat. No announcement required.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: Your Core brightens near the return-gate. You know when someone is coming home.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: The rescue furnace promised shelter. You are allowed to receive that warmth too.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: A watchstone cannot protect its garden by wearing itself out. Rest with us.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: You found the way out, Moonkip. That matters more than what stayed in the chest.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: Put the burden down, Pebblewyrm. We will still depend on you tomorrow.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: The shell remembers a voice. Let it finish before you answer with a song.

LINES.speaker: Relic Keeper
LINES.text: Your place here does not depend on being noticed, Gloomlet. I kept it for you.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: Courier satchels carried promised returns. Yours may help us trace an old route.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: I found a furnace record naming the workers who promised shelter. You would like them.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: Your watchstone guarded a garden. Tell me what still grows there.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: A locked bell tower with no sign of entry. Moonkip, I would value an honest account.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: Foundation Cores supported ordinary homes. Those histories deserve names too.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: We can record the drowned song together. I will not ask you to keep quiet for the whole day.

LINES.speaker: Archivist
LINES.text: You brought back an overlooked keepsake. I will record its owner, not the rescuer.

PERSONALITY.ashtrail_hunter: Fresh tracks outside the gate. Two feet, then four. Watch the bends.
PERSONALITY.nightstage_drifter: An encore is only worth it if the whole audience survives.
PERSONALITY.ruin_warden: Drink something warm. I will watch the gate.
PERSONALITY.vault_runner: A rich vault with one exit is a trap with expensive wallpaper.
PERSONALITY.velvet_astrologer: The sky gives probabilities. I pack bandages.

boss_defeated.speaker: Archivist
boss_defeated.text: The guardian has fallen. Take the treasure; leave the names on the walls.

boss_defeated.speaker: Salvager
boss_defeated.text: Boss-grade salvage. My insurance company has gone very quiet.

boss_defeated.speaker: Relic Keeper
boss_defeated.text: The vault has stopped holding its breath. Listen.

cache_opened.speaker: Salvager
cache_opened.text: Cache opened. Contents are yours; equipping them is a separate decision.

cache_opened.speaker: Mascot
cache_opened.text: An actual chest! I appreciate a container that respects the job description.

cache_opened.speaker: Archivist
cache_opened.text: Recovered from a sealed cache. Previous owner: conspicuously absent.

contract_complete.speaker: Archivist
contract_complete.text: Contract complete. Claim your payment at Local Contracts; admiration is not legal tender.

contract_complete.speaker: Salvager
contract_complete.text: You did the job. Collect the Gold before somebody invents a processing fee.

early_defeat.speaker: Salvager
early_defeat.text: Gold and Shards earned are yours. Try armour or healing upgrades before the next trip.

early_defeat.speaker: Archivist
early_defeat.text: A failed expedition is still evidence. The floor supplied most of it.

early_defeat.speaker: Mascot
early_defeat.text: I have assessed the situation. The situation has a very hard floor.

epic_find.speaker: Salvager
epic_find.text: Epic gear. Compare the effects before the colour makes the decision for you.

epic_find.speaker: Archivist
epic_find.text: A valuable find. Please resist using it to point at the valuable find.

epic_find.speaker: Mascot
epic_find.text: Purple. Very dignified. I shall ruin that immediately.

first_visit.speaker: Archivist
first_visit.text: Begin Expedition takes you into the ruins. Gear, upgrades and the Archive can wait until you return.

first_visit.speaker: Salvager
first_visit.text: Welcome home. Gold buys supplies; Scrap feeds the Forge. Keep both away from my lunch.

first_visit.speaker: Relic Keeper
first_visit.text: A safe gate, warm lanterns, people who remember your name. We start there.

forge_evolved.speaker: Salvager
forge_evolved.text: Same weapon, new behaviour. Try it on something that is not my door.

forge_evolved.speaker: Salvager
forge_evolved.text: Evolution complete. The warranty has fled into the hills.

idle.speaker: Salvager
idle.text: I tested that hinge. It passed. The wall is appealing.

idle.speaker: Salvager
idle.text: Repair, reuse, occasionally run away. Sustainable business.

idle.speaker: Archivist
idle.text: The Crown indexed every relic and forgot every person. We are correcting the catalogue.

idle.speaker: Archivist
idle.text: The forbidden shelf is locked. This has mainly improved its marketing.

idle.speaker: Relic Keeper
idle.text: A Core is a promise someone kept alive. Listen before you decide what it is worth.

idle.speaker: Relic Keeper
idle.text: You may rest here. The world will remain inconvenient tomorrow.

idle.speaker: Mascot
idle.text: I packed provisions. Most of them are provisions for me.

large_hoard.speaker: Salvager
large_hoard.text: The hoard needs another shelf. The shelf needs hazard pay.

large_hoard.speaker: Archivist
large_hoard.text: Your collection now has a table of contents. It is mostly warnings.

large_hoard.speaker: Mascot
large_hoard.text: Enough treasure to swim in. I have been advised to try a chair instead.

legendary_find.speaker: Salvager
legendary_find.text: Legendary. Read the signature; that is where the interesting trouble lives.

legendary_find.speaker: Archivist
legendary_find.text: A relic survived the fall of an empire. You have survived carrying it across the room.

legendary_find.speaker: Relic Keeper
legendary_find.text: This Core remembers its maker. Be gentle with that memory.

legendary_find.speaker: Mascot
legendary_find.text: Legendary acquired. Modesty has been unequipped.

new_weapon.speaker: Salvager
new_weapon.text: Check the weapon family before you swap. A bigger number is not the whole build.

new_weapon.speaker: Mascot
new_weapon.text: New weapon. Same suspiciously confident paws.

rare.speaker: Archivist
rare.text: The old vault map says HERE BE ACCOUNTANTS. We have found worse things.

rare.speaker: Salvager
rare.text: I once dated a prophet. Wonderful nights. Terrible surprises. We both knew how it would end.

rare.speaker: Relic Keeper
rare.text: Sometimes the Core remembers a sky we have never seen. Those are the quiet nights.

returning.speaker: Salvager
returning.text: There you are. I left the lamp burning. Before you get sentimental, lamp oil goes on the invoice.

returning.speaker: Archivist
returning.text: Sit. Names first, injuries second, heroic embellishments in the appendix. There is tea.

returning.speaker: Relic Keeper
returning.text: The gate brought you home. That matters more than what was in your hands.

shop_purchase.speaker: Salvager
shop_purchase.text: Sold. Inspect the effects, then equip or store it. Regret is sold separately.

shop_purchase.speaker: Salvager
shop_purchase.text: I checked the straps. The curse department has not returned my call.

shop_purchase.speaker: Mascot
shop_purchase.text: A sensible purchase. Somebody write that down before it stops being true.

shrine_upgrade.speaker: Relic Keeper
shrine_upgrade.text: That power stays with you between expeditions. The Core remembers.

shrine_upgrade.speaker: Relic Keeper
shrine_upgrade.text: There. Stronger, not invincible. Please do not test the difference on my roof.

shrine_upgrade.speaker: Mascot
shrine_upgrade.text: Permanent upgrade. Temporary urge to lift the furniture.

signature_find.speaker: Archivist
signature_find.text: A named relic. Read its signature before you equip it; old bargains rarely use small print.

signature_find.speaker: Relic Keeper
signature_find.text: Someone carried this through the Crownfall. We owe it more than a price tag.

tapped.speaker: Salvager
tapped.text: Need gear? Shop is to my right. Unsolicited repair advice is regrettably free.

tapped.speaker: Salvager
tapped.text: That lever is decorative. This warning is based on several experiments.

tapped.speaker: Archivist
tapped.text: Trophies, notes and memories are in the Archive. Yes, we keep the embarrassing ones.

tapped.speaker: Archivist
tapped.text: You may revise your plan. You may not revise the witness statement.

tapped.speaker: Relic Keeper
tapped.text: The shrine spends Star Shards on permanent power. Gold pays for Hideout improvements.

tapped.speaker: Relic Keeper
tapped.text: You are allowed to put the satchel down. That is not a defeat condition.

tapped.speaker: Mascot
tapped.text: Point me at the ruins. I have a sword and a deeply unearned sense of readiness.

travel.speaker: Mascot
travel.text: Small paws. Large sword. The staircase has filed a complaint.

travel.speaker: Archivist
travel.text: A named windup means an attack is coming. Keep your eyes on the foe, not the coin shower.

travel.speaker: Salvager
travel.text: Spend Run Scrip at roadside merchants. Unspent Scrip expires when the expedition ends.

travel.speaker: Relic Keeper
travel.text: Healing and armour keep ambitious builds alive. Power without a way home is a poor bargain.

travel.speaker: Archivist
travel.text: Tap the arena for extra strikes. Menus and the HUD are safe to touch.

travel.speaker: Mascot
travel.text: If a corridor feels suspiciously generous, check whether it has teeth.

trophy_earned.speaker: Archivist
trophy_earned.text: Filed under improbable achievements. That shelf is becoming a problem.

trophy_earned.speaker: Salvager
trophy_earned.text: A trophy! Finally, a dent nobody expects me to repair.

variant_seen.speaker: Archivist
variant_seen.text: That foe has a modifier. Read the badge; the usual assumptions may be expensive.

variant_seen.speaker: Mascot
variant_seen.text: New variety of bad idea. I was hoping for a new variety of biscuit.

victory.speaker: Salvager
victory.text: Boss down, gear secured. Check your stash before spending the celebration fund.

victory.speaker: Archivist
victory.text: The vault is open. Its history is not finished with us.

victory.speaker: Relic Keeper
victory.text: You brought a forgotten promise home. For tonight, that is enough.

victory.speaker: Mascot
victory.text: We won. I would like the victory feast to begin before the credits.

Boss.desc: Defeat the guardian. Open its three-choice Hoard.
Boss.title: THE FINAL VAULT

Combat.desc: Three foes. Choose targets; clear the patrol.
Combat.title: PATROL CHAMBER

Merchant.desc: Spend your Run Scrip. Existing shop tradeoffs.
Merchant.title: PACK PEDDLER

Rest.desc: Recover 22% of maximum HP. No currency cost.
Rest.title: QUIET CAMP

Risk.desc: A stronger three-foe patrol. Ordinary drop rules.
Risk.title: CURSED CROSSING

Shrine.desc: Choose one free run upgrade. No permanent stats.
Shrine.title: RELIC SHRINE

Treasure.desc: Open a Relic Chest. One guaranteed item.
Treasure.title: SEALED TREASURY

choices.desc: One Epic+ item. Next foe deals 20% more damage.
choices.name: Accept the debt

choices.desc: Gain 20 Run Scrip. No curse.
choices.name: Break the contract

cursed_coffer.line: A courier coffer offers treasure today. The scarred latch explains the terms.
cursed_coffer.title: INTEREST DUE

choices.desc: Gain 30 XP and recover 8 HP.
choices.name: Make a careful copy

choices.desc: Gain 35 Run Scrip. Preserve the page.
choices.name: Recover the metal seal

ink_witness.line: A name survives beneath a Crown correction. Ilex left room in her ledger.
ink_witness.title: SOMEONE WAS HERE

choices.desc: Spend 45 Run Scrip for 12 ward.
choices.name: Buy the lantern

choices.desc: Gain 20 Run Scrip.
choices.name: Sell the dented bracket

lantern_bargain.line: Merrow has a spare lantern and absolutely no explanation for the teeth marks.
lantern_bargain.title: THE LONG WAY HOME

choices.desc: One Epic+ item; next foe deals 20% more damage.
choices.name: Accept the tooth tax

choices.desc: Gain 35 XP. Leave its lunch alone.
choices.name: Trade an honest story

mimic_parley.line: The chest clears its throat. It offers a polite bargain before resorting to the old impolite one.
mimic_parley.title: TEETH BEHIND THE RECEIPT

choices.desc: Lose 10 HP. Next foe takes 25% more hit damage.
choices.name: Take the measured risk

choices.desc: Recover 10 HP.
choices.name: Leave a ripple

mirror_pool.line: Your reflection reaches for the treasure first. It has always been rude.
mirror_pool.title: THE WRONG REFLECTION

choices.desc: Spend 25 Run Scrip, recover 25 HP.
choices.name: Trade for repairs

choices.desc: Gain 25 Run Scrip.
choices.name: Collect the useful bits

patch_warranty.line: Patch's discarded warranty reads: valid until the first interesting noise.
patch_warranty.title: ONE CAREFUL OWNER

choices.desc: Spend 40 Run Scrip for a run upgrade.
choices.name: Leave a useful offering

choices.desc: Recover 12 HP. Leave the relic where it belongs.
choices.name: Keep its light safe

promise_shrine.line: The Core hums beside an empty cradle. Sera's words return: ask before taking.
promise_shrine.title: THE UNFINISHED PROMISE

choices.desc: Lose 12 HP for one Rare+ item.
choices.name: Break the seal

choices.desc: Gain 25 Run Scrip. Leave the dangerous seal alone.
choices.name: Pick the quiet latch

sealed_cache.line: Three hinges. Two warnings. One promise of something worth the trouble.
sealed_cache.title: A LOCK WITH OPINIONS

choices.desc: Lose 10 HP for one Epic+ find. Record the bell-door clue.
choices.name: Open the quiet door

choices.desc: Gain 30 XP; keep the clue in your field collection.
choices.name: Copy the hinge marks

secret_bell.line: Three scratches point beneath a bridge. Someone left the latch warm. Follow the quiet, not the gold.
secret_bell.title: THE BELL THAT DIDN'T RING

choices.desc: Spend 180 Run Scrip for one Epic+ item.
choices.name: Commission a road find

choices.desc: Recover 12 HP. No payment.
choices.name: Share a good route

wandering_smith.line: A travelling Compact smith has a fireproof backpack and very little patience for your nickname.
wandering_smith.title: A FORGE ON TWO FEET

choices.desc: Lose 8 HP, gain 45 Run Scrip.
choices.name: Lift the sign

choices.desc: Spend 30 Run Scrip, recover 18 HP.
choices.name: Share supplies

wounded_courier.line: A Compact courier is pinned beneath a fallen sign. Their satchel is intact.
wounded_courier.title: A LIGHT STILL MOVING

UPGRADES.desc: Taps gain 80% of base hit power
UPGRADES.name: STATIC FINGERS

UPGRADES.desc: Carry damage into the next foe
UPGRADES.name: CINDER WAKE

UPGRADES.desc: Strengthen damage over time from burns
UPGRADES.name: EMBER TEETH

ITEMS.desc: Heavy steel, a steady grip, and no intention of asking the lock nicely.
ITEMS.name: Scrapfang Blade

ITEMS.desc: A hammer with a hungry grin. Its kill blast carries trouble forward.
ITEMS.name: Mimic Mallet

ITEMS.desc: Light limbs, quick shots. The previous owner was less quick.
ITEMS.name: Bonebow

ITEMS.desc: Every fifth spell echoes. Even the staff enjoys a second opinion.
ITEMS.name: Glimmerstaff

ITEMS.desc: Quick blades for critical hits and finishing wounded foes. Subtlety optional.
ITEMS.name: Moonbite Daggers

ITEMS.desc: Living bark cushions hits and grows vitality.
ITEMS.name: Mossguard Harness

ITEMS.desc: Heavy plating trades speed for force.
ITEMS.name: Ironpaw Plate

ITEMS.desc: More Run Scrip from kills. Spend the proceeds before the expedition ends.
ITEMS.name: Hoarder's Locket

ITEMS.desc: Strength at low health costs maximum HP. The inscription says probably.
ITEMS.name: Definitely Not Cursed Ring

ITEMS.desc: An ember sealed in old kiln-glass. Strengthens burns and blasts on kills.
ITEMS.name: Ember Pop Rune

ITEMS.desc: Critical hits call a lightning spark.
ITEMS.name: Stormspark Rune

ITEMS.desc: Poison stacks faster and lingers longer.
ITEMS.name: Toxic Burst Rune

ITEMS.desc: A deep-earth seal that lends weight to heavy strikes against guardians.
ITEMS.name: Ground Slam Rune

ITEMS.desc: A salt-dark blade that lands like an anchor.
ITEMS.name: Sunken Cleaver

ITEMS.desc: Ugly, eager and remarkably accurate.
ITEMS.name: Crooked Longbow

ITEMS.desc: Vault-thread reinforcement protects the wearer and keeps scavenged Scrip close.
ITEMS.name: Ruinweave Coat

ITEMS.desc: A salvaged guardian scale, bound over the heart for the next hunt.
ITEMS.name: Dragon-Scale Patch

ITEMS.desc: Rings when treasure is pretending not to exist.
ITEMS.name: Suspicious Lucky Bell

ITEMS.desc: Tugs loose relic energy into useful patterns.
ITEMS.name: Relic Magnet Charm

ITEMS.desc: The ruins remember a good hit.
ITEMS.name: Echo Rune

ITEMS.desc: A patient little curse in polished stone.
ITEMS.name: Mire Rune

ITEMS.desc: A moon-bright slab forged to break the armour of fallen Crown sentries.
ITEMS.name: Moonsteel Slab

ITEMS.desc: Small handle. Unreasonably geological conclusion.
ITEMS.name: Pebble Pounder

ITEMS.desc: A silver-limbed bow that rewards patient aim.
ITEMS.name: Moonbranch

ITEMS.desc: Fast, flashy, and suspiciously interested in profit.
ITEMS.name: Gilded Shortbow

ITEMS.desc: Its warm Core has never heard of indoor casting rules.
ITEMS.name: Cinder Staff

ITEMS.desc: Patient magic with roots in inconvenient places.
ITEMS.name: Moss Staff

ITEMS.desc: Two sharp arguments assembled from one bad machine.
ITEMS.name: Scrap Shivs

ITEMS.desc: Treasure that cuts out the middle merchant.
ITEMS.name: Gilded Knives

ITEMS.desc: Every patch remembers a different near miss.
ITEMS.name: Patchplate Vest

ITEMS.desc: Armour with pockets deep enough to affect posture.
ITEMS.name: Coinstitch Coat

ITEMS.desc: Rings shortly before something educational happens.
ITEMS.name: Tiny Bell of Warning

ITEMS.desc: Proof that the vault definitely owes you treasure.
ITEMS.name: Vault Receipt

ITEMS.desc: A very short instruction ending in an exclamation mark.
ITEMS.name: Critical Script

ITEMS.desc: Tiny engraving. Extremely large grudge.
ITEMS.name: Bossbane Sigil

ITEMS.desc: The fourth hit you survive earns a thorn in reply.
ITEMS.name: Thorn Receipt

ITEMS.desc: The first burn or poison on each foe grants 3 ward. Ward holds at most 15.
ITEMS.name: Promise Bubble

ITEMS.desc: Heavy hits return 25% base power after a short beat. The echo stays with its target.
ITEMS.name: Echo Invoice

ITEMS.desc: Opening a courier cache primes the next hit for +40% power. Does not stack.
ITEMS.name: Courier's Appetite

ITEMS.desc: Hit three different foes within 4 seconds to spark the third for 60% base power.
ITEMS.name: Storm Ledger

ITEMS.desc: The first hit delays each foe. A heavy follow-up shatters the chime for 25% base power.
ITEMS.name: Frostbell Seal

ITEMS.desc: More Run Scrip and stronger hits. Incoming damage rises 15%. Read the terms.
ITEMS.name: Gilded Debt

ITEMS.desc: A slow bell-maul. Every heavy hit delays its target by 0.25s.
ITEMS.name: Burden Bell

ITEMS.desc: Each foe's first critical hit calls a spark. Fast shots, no free shelter.
ITEMS.name: Lanternstring

ITEMS.desc: A staff that remembers rough treatment. Every fourth hit taken answers with a thorn.
ITEMS.name: Returning Thorn

ITEMS.desc: Once per run, fatal damage leaves one HP. A narrow margin, not an extra life.
ITEMS.name: Last Page

ITEMS.desc: Each critical kill restores 4 ward, up to 15. Finish cleanly; carry the shelter.
ITEMS.name: Quiet Chime

ITEMS.desc: A heavy promise: delayed echoes reward deliberate hits.
ITEMS.name: Oath Slab

ITEMS.desc: Survive four hits and the roots answer. A bruiser's axe, not a quick escape.
ITEMS.name: Root Splitter

ITEMS.desc: The first critical hit calls a spark. Thin armour leaves no room for stage fright.
ITEMS.name: Moonstage Shivs

ITEMS.desc: A first-hit chime buys time to carry your promise to the next door.
ITEMS.name: Courier Pike

ITEMS.desc: Heavy hits stagger; furnace heat turns the recovery beat into a burn window.
ITEMS.name: Bellows Maul

ITEMS.desc: Bank a kill's impact, then spring. Close-range risk travels with the prize.
ITEMS.name: Rivet Fangs

ITEMS.desc: Every fifth shot calls lightning. Precision pays; haste is optional.
ITEMS.name: Witness Bow

ITEMS.desc: Relic coils remember the first critical bolt against each target.
ITEMS.name: Coil Dispatch

ITEMS.desc: A five-shot lightning rhythm with room to carry more treasure.
ITEMS.name: Pilgrim Sling

ITEMS.desc: Mark three different foes in quick succession to complete its lightning circuit.
ITEMS.name: Marginalia Staff

ITEMS.desc: Silence is a first-hit delay. Poison uses the quiet time.
ITEMS.name: Hush Wand

ITEMS.desc: Cache-fed magic: the next hit gains stored force. Incoming damage rises.
ITEMS.name: Debt Orbit

ITEMS.desc: Critical kills grant ward. Thin fabric favors finishing before retaliation.
ITEMS.name: Second Skin

ITEMS.desc: Four survived hits earn a counterstroke; its weight slows attacks.
ITEMS.name: Warden Warranty

ITEMS.desc: Below 40% HP, your attack rhythm accelerates. The red ink is yours.
ITEMS.name: Scarlet Margin

ITEMS.desc: One fatal mistake leaves one HP. After that, the coat has no promises.
ITEMS.name: Keeper Coat

ITEMS.desc: Burn or poison wakes ward once per foe. Patient status builds keep their shelter.
ITEMS.name: Marsh Promise

ITEMS.desc: Defeated foes leave impact for the next. The ring expects you to keep moving.
ITEMS.name: Receipt Ring

ITEMS.desc: Critical finishes store ward. A measured shot earns a safer next room.
ITEMS.name: Safe Aperture

ITEMS.desc: Cache openings prime the next hit; carrying its fortune also invites sharper blows.
ITEMS.name: Coffer Key

ITEMS.desc: Three distinct targets make a lightning circuit. Solo duels need another plan.
ITEMS.name: Threefold Ink

ITEMS.desc: Heavy hits echo to the same foe. Slow beats can tell the story twice.
ITEMS.name: Fault Script

ITEMS.desc: Burn and poison wake ward. It rewards application, not an endless shield.
ITEMS.name: Shelter Script

ITEMS.desc: First-hit chimes shatter under a heavy follow-up. Timing is the signature.
ITEMS.name: Winter Clause

ITEMS.desc: Three targets close a storm circuit. Poison lingers; its living roots borrow your vitality.
ITEMS.name: Gravebloom Staff

ITEMS.desc: A deep-Siege keepsake. Kills bank force for the next foe; carrying it invites harder hits.
ITEMS.name: The Last Receipt

UPGRADES.name: STATIC FINGERS

UPGRADES.name: CINDER WAKE

UPGRADES.name: EMBER TEETH

emberhorn.lore: A warm-hearted bruiser with a spark to prove.

glimmerfin.lore: A tide-touched mage with impossible pockets.

gloomlet.lore: A shadowy little menace who insists it was an accident.

moonkip.lore: A nimble moonlit rogue who pockets trouble.

mosskin.lore: A steadfast guardian grown around ancient stone.

pebblewyrm.lore: A tiny rocky powerhouse with enormous confidence.

relic_beast.lore: A curious scavenger with a brave little Core.

ashtrail_hunter.bio: He follows ruined mechanisms like other hunters follow tracks. A good bolt is cheaper than a bad bargain.

nightstage_drifter.bio: The old stage is rubble. The audience is hostile. Leaving a memorable last line still matters.

ruin_warden.bio: He stayed when the Crown's patrol withdrew. His coat remembers every person who made it home.

vault_runner.bio: Compact routes taught her to travel light and carry heavy promises. She collects broken keys, not excuses.

velvet_astrologer.bio: A careful reader of unstable skies. Her forecasts name possibilities, never debts owed by the future.

furnace_regent.line: Every debt feeds the furnace. It accepts no refunds.
furnace_regent.name: The Furnace Regent

grump_knight.line: The old toll is unpaid. He intends to collect it from someone still breathing.
grump_knight.name: Grump Knight

hoard_dragon.line: The dragon counts treasure in coins, and trespassers in bones.
hoard_dragon.name: The Hoard Dragon

verdant_mirror.line: Its roots hold the forest spring. Downstream, the gardens are dying.
verdant_mirror.name: The Verdant Mirror

lines: Starfall's official history misplaced entire families. Ilex kept their names.
She arrived with six trunks of evidence and a very short opinion of kings.
'A blank page is not permission to forget. Bring witnesses. And a sturdier shelf.'
ilex.name: Ilex Quill

lines: Patch found a gate that had outlived the wall. Typical royal engineering.
He built the Hideout around it. Nobody here would come home to a locked door.
'Repairs cost money. Coming home doesn't. Wipe your boots.'
patch.name: Patch Brasswick

lines: The Crown priced living Cores by weight. Sera asked what a promise weighed.
The committee disliked the question. She left with their research and the people it endangered.
'Ancient power can wait. You are bleeding on my notes.'
sera.name: Sera Vey

cinder_exile.line: You left the ashes. They did not leave you.
cinder_exile.name: Cinder Exile

gearworks_tinker.line: Nothing is broken until you run out of pockets.
gearworks_tinker.name: Gearworks Tinker

lantern_warden.line: Keep the light. Count everyone home.
lantern_warden.name: Lantern Warden

moonfen_rogue.line: The fen taught you which promises float.
moonfen_rogue.name: Moonfen Rogue

relic_priest.line: Old things remember. You try to ask politely.
relic_priest.name: Relic Priest

starfall_witch.line: You learned to listen when the sky cracked.
starfall_witch.name: Starfall Witch

vault_hunter.line: Some doors are locked. Others are merely expensive.
vault_hunter.name: Vault Hunter

wilds_ranger.line: Tracks tell the truth. Treasure maps rarely do.
wilds_ranger.name: Wilds Ranger

claws.desc: Two fast swipes, each at 55% damage.

crossbow.desc: Every third trigger fires two hits at 64% each.

greataxe.desc: Every third attack chops for +45% damage.

sling.desc: Every third shot staggers the foe by 0.18s. Arcing stones.

spear.desc: The opening strike against each foe deals +30% damage.

wand.desc: Fast sparks. Every third cast repeats its element.

emberhorn: I warmed the treasure. You're welcome.
glimmerfin: The tide says shiny. I trust the tide.
gloomlet: No witnesses. Except that judgmental lamp.
That coin was already following me.
moonkip: I borrowed the key before we needed it.
mosskin: Everyone behind me. Even the snacks.
That lock needs patience. Or a very large shield.
pebblewyrm: I can carry it. I didn't ask how big.
relic_beast: The chest sneezed. I sneezed back.
My satchel has room. Emotionally, at least.

NPC_NOTES.Ilex Quill: An adult occult archivist from Starfall who fled before her name could be erased. Ilex treats Lootlings as witnesses, not curiosities. Her footnotes are precise; her jokes are not kind to tyrants.
NPC_NOTES.Patch Brasswick: An adult travelling tinker who rebuilt the Hideout gate from salvage. Patch trusts Lootlings more than contracts. He sells repairs with dry humour, and keeps the old rescue furnace burning for Emberhorn.
NPC_NOTES.Sera Vey: An adult relic scholar tending the crystal shrine. Sera left the Crown's scholars when they began pricing living Cores. Warm, practical and unafraid to tell ancient power to wait its turn.

ORIGINS.emberhorn: Woke in a cold rescue furnace. Impatient, affectionate and terrified of letting others down. Collects useful metal to keep the Hideout warm; claims singed eyebrows prove good planning.
ORIGINS.glimmerfin: Woke when a drowned song reached the surface. Theatrical, generous and afraid of silence. Hunts relics that remember voices; announces victories as encores nobody requested.
ORIGINS.gloomlet: Slipped out of a cracked shadow mirror. Dry, affectionate in secret and frightened of being forgotten. Collects things their owners stopped noticing. Denies every suspiciously helpful deed.
ORIGINS.moonkip: First appeared inside a locked bell tower. Proudly sneaky but unable to leave a friend behind. Collects keys and impossible locks. Calls every theft a temporary relocation.
ORIGINS.mosskin: Grew around a watchstone guarding an abandoned garden. Patient and quietly funny. Fears being too late to protect someone. Returns stolen relics to places that need them, not owners who hoard them.
ORIGINS.pebblewyrm: Hatched from a quarry's discarded foundation Core. Cheerful, stubborn and afraid of deep water. Treasures well-made tools and carries everyone's bags without admitting that some are heavy.
ORIGINS.relic_beast: Found asleep in a courier's satchel after Crownfall. Curious and loyal; hates empty promises. Hunts treasure to return lost things, although snacks occasionally take priority.

constants.PREMISE: The Crownfall scattered a civilisation's promises into Relic Cores. Lootlings woke around those fragments, small enough to enter the ruins and stubborn enough to bring their stories home. Treasure is useful. A forgotten promise can change the world.

act_i: Your Core remembers this road. Someone meant to come back.
The Crown fell. Its vaults still guard the promises inside.
The Hoard Dragon keeps what others were sworn to return.
The vault opens. Forgotten names see daylight again.
Beyond the ruins, a jade pool holds the forest's lost spring.
cinder_crown: The furnace has crowned a new tyrant.
The Furnace Regent accepts no refunds.
The crown cools. The debts remain.
A star has fallen into the Archive.
first_hoard: The first treasure was a promise, not a coin.
The Hollow Crown still demands everything.
A promise recovered. Not a world repaired.
Something beyond the vault heard you.
frostbell_hollows: A warning bell still rings inside the frozen ruins.
Relic Cores trapped in the ice remember unfinished songs.
Belljaw has swallowed the last chime. Break its hold on the bell.
Belljaw falls. The warning finally stops.
Meltwater leads to workshops that drowned during Crownfall.
moonfen: Follow the path through the marsh. Moving lanterns can lead you away from it.
Crownfall left false lights among the old trail markers.
The Lantern Jackal hunts travellers who follow its lights.
The Jackal falls. Its false lights go dark.
Beyond the marsh, a warning bell rings beneath the ice.
mossglass_wilds: Roots claimed the Crown's treasure. Better landlords.
Every leaf reflects a different sky. None of them is today's.
The Mirror stole the spring. Downstream, nothing flowers.
Water finds its old path. Something stolen gets to go home.
Lanterns wait in Moonfen. Ilex has underlined 'wait'.
nullglass_expanse: The broken Cores here show reflections of choices nobody made.
Your reflection moves late. Watch the real path under your feet.
The Unchosen gathers those abandoned reflections into a body.
You leave the reflections behind and return alive.
Above the glass, chains hold the last sky-road.
skyhook_bastion: The last sky-road hangs from the Bastion's chains.
The Crown's old toll guards still bar the crossing.
The Chainwarden keeps the road locked. Defeat it to reopen the route.
The old roads converge at the First Hoard.
starfall_archive: The Archive's records are being rewritten, including its maps of the stars.
Ilex fled when the Redactor began erasing people's names.
The Redactor would erase your account of what happened here.
Your account survives. Others still need their names restored.
Recovered pages describe a land of broken reflections.
sunken_gearworks: The shift bell rings. Nobody has answered in a century.
Brass lungs breathe. Their makers' names have rusted away.
The Engine has a vacancy. Its last worker is still chained.
The shift ends. Leave the ledger open. They were owed more.
Above the works, a furnace has awarded itself a crown.

Archivist.emberhorn: Ash is not an acceptable signature.
Archivist.glimmerfin: The tide remembers every passage. Tell me where yours led.
Archivist.gloomlet: A blank page is not an erased name.
Archivist.moonkip: Return the bookmark. It opens nothing. Usually.
Archivist.mosskin: The Archive appreciates your shade. Not your roots.
Archivist.pebblewyrm: The book was heavy. The shelf was heavier.
Archivist.relic_beast: Your pawprints are now an official marginal note.

Relic Keeper.emberhorn: Warmth is a gift. Burning the rug isn't.
Relic Keeper.glimmerfin: That old song belongs here. Sing softly.
Relic Keeper.gloomlet: I remember you. You needn't hide to stay.
Relic Keeper.moonkip: The shrine is unlocked. You can stop looking pleased.
Relic Keeper.mosskin: Even watchstones need a rest. Sit with me.
Relic Keeper.pebblewyrm: You don't have to carry everyone, little mountain.
Relic Keeper.relic_beast: A brave Core. A suspicious number of crumbs.

Salvager.emberhorn: Warm the forge, not my invoices.
Salvager.glimmerfin: No encores near the hot metal.
Salvager.gloomlet: I saw that coin move. It wasn't the wind.
Salvager.moonkip: The keys stay on this side of the counter.
Salvager.mosskin: Your shield's growing leaves again. I charge for pruning.
Salvager.pebblewyrm: You dented the hammer? I'm almost impressed.
Salvager.relic_beast: Empty the satchel before I weigh it. Snacks don't count.
